# A facet and rows without el

Valid.

The page offers one facet, "Focus", with one option, "New core". Without a facet applied, the
table shows three rows as usual. With "New core" applied, the reader keeps `add()` in full view
(its `el` is in the set) and dims `sub()` (not in the set). The third row, "lambda in a test",
has no `el`, so it stays as it is: not dimmed and not hidden, even with "Hide the rest" on.
